invariants.rationale: data is used in the implementation, so it should not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
func is passed to a wrapper and ultimately called, so it should not be null.
parallelism is accepted as an Integer argument and may be required for downstream operations.
Parallelism typically must be positive if provided, though may be left null for default.
